story: On a Monday in July, Sara and Ivan meet at a cafe. Sara sits on a seat and drinks from a purple cup. Ivan has a water bottle and says hello. They listen to the music and talk about nothing else but the hot weather.
title: A Hot Monday
setting: A sunny outdoor cafe in July.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: a girl with long brown hair and a white shirt

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: a boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt

sentences.en: It is a hot Monday in July.
sentences.zh: 这是七月里一个炎热的星期一。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara and Ivan stand under a bright sun in a park.

sentences.en: Sara finds a seat at the cafe.
sentences.zh: 萨拉在咖啡馆找了一个座位。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara with long brown hair walks toward a wooden chair.

sentences.en: She wants to sit down now.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara sits on a wooden chair at a small table.

sentences.en: She holds a purple cup in her hand.
sentences.zh: 她手里拿着一个紫色的杯子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara holds a purple cup near her face.

sentences.en: Ivan says hello to her again.
sentences.zh: 伊万再一次向她打招呼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan with short black hair waves his hand at Sara.

sentences.en: He puts a water bottle on top.
sentences.zh: 他把一个水瓶放在上面。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan places a clear water bottle on the top of the table.

sentences.en: The temperature is not zero today.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan looks at the bright sun in the blue sky.

sentences.en: They listen to the music together.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara and Ivan sit at the table and look happy.

sentences.en: This is her last drink today.
sentences.zh: 这是她今天的最后一杯饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara holds her purple cup and looks at the empty cup.

sentences.en: They do not talk about anything else.
sentences.zh: 他们不谈论其他任何事情。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara and Ivan sit together and smile at each other.
